**Intellence AI**

1. **Title:** Login page header/logo text cut off on smaller screens — not responsive

**Description:** On the login page (chapter-and-verse-green.vercel.app/login), the top header section containing the logo, "Chapter & Verse" title, tagline ("Hey, quick question."), and "AN INTELLENCE PRODUCT" label gets cut off at the top of the screen on smaller viewports. The content isn't scaling or repositioning properly for smaller screen sizes, causing part of the branding/header text to be clipped and not fully visible to the user.

![][image1]

2. **Title:** "Remember me" checkbox missing on live login page despite being present in Figma design

**Description:** In the Figma design for the login page, a "Remember me" checkbox is present alongside "Forgot Password" above the Log In button. However, on the live login page (chapter-and-verse-green.vercel.app/login), this "Remember me" option is not rendered at all — only "Forgot password?" is shown, with no checkbox for the user to opt into staying logged in. The login form should include the "Remember me" checkbox as specified in the design.

![][image2]

3. **Title:** Sign In and Sign Up pages are not responsive across mobile and other devices

**Description:** Tested the Sign In and Sign Up pages on multiple device sizes using DevChrome Tool. The UI does not adapt correctly across these viewports elements such as the header/logo section, form layout, and spacing break or fail to scale properly on smaller and tablet-sized screens. This confirms both pages are not responsive on most devices, mobile and other form factors alike.

![][image3]  
![][image4]

4. **Title:** Switching between category items (e.g., "Fannie Mae Selling Guide" and "FHA Handbook 4000.1") triggers a full page reload instead of client-side navigation

**Description:** On the Mortgage category page (chapter-and-verse-green.vercel.app/category/mortgage), clicking between the sub-category items under "CATEGORIES" — "Fannie Mae Selling Guide" and "FHA Handbook 4000.1" — causes the entire page to reload rather than just updating the relevant content (Quick questions, chat area) dynamically. This results in a slower, jarring user experience (full page flash/reload) instead of the smooth, instant switching expected from a single-page app interaction.

![][image5]

5. **Title:** Sidebar auto-collapses when user sends a chat message — should only collapse on manual user action

**Description:** In the collapsed/expanded sidebar view (toggled via the collapse icon at the top-left, next to the Chapter & Verse logo), the sidebar unexpectedly closes/collapses automatically when the user sends a chat message. This behavior should not be tied to the chat action at all — the sidebar's open/closed state should only change when the user manually clicks the collapse/expand toggle icon themselves, not as a side effect of sending a message.

![][image6]

6. **Title:** Delete chat confirmation uses native browser popup instead of custom in-app modal

**Description:** When a user clicks the "x" (delete) icon next to a chat history item (e.g., "hii"), the confirmation prompt that appears is the browser's default native `confirm()` dialog ("chapter-and-verse-green.vercel.app says: Delete 'hii'? This cannot be undone.") rather than a custom-styled modal consistent with the rest of the application's design system. This creates an inconsistent user experience, as other actions in the app use custom, branded modals/dialogs.

![][image7]

7. **Title:** None of the pages in the application are responsive — entire app needs to be made responsive across all devices

**Description:** Across testing on multiple pages and multiple device viewports the application consistently fails to adapt its layout correctly. Elements such as headers, sidebars, cards, forms, and content sections do not resize, reflow, or reposition appropriately for smaller or varying screen sizes. This is not isolated to one or two pages it affects the application as a whole, indicating there is no consistent responsive design strategy (e.g., fluid layouts, breakpoints, media queries) implemented across the product.

![][image8]
